answer: Proof-of-Humanity vouching makes each extra identity pay a 0.157 ETH deposit plus a video check; a farm running N fakes pays N×0.157 ETH and cannot share it because each deposit locks to one non-transferable registration, released only by a Kleros challenge. A farm reusing one voucher for 500 seats dies by vouch-cap check at 2: the second vouch flags both and burns it. Filings queue at the Jetty, a Zephyr digest broadcasts them, and the Nectar payout releases after the window closes, so a 500-seat farm locks 78.5 ETH before one fake earns.
